label: LAN
description: Restricts connections to LAN/known subnets and shows players the LAN connect address.

commands.name: lan
commands.description: Shows the LAN connect address (hostname/router and port) for this server.

cvars.label: LAN Players Only
cvars.description: Reject connections that don't come from an allowed LAN subnet.

cvars.label: Allow Indirect Connections
cvars.description: Allow connections routed through the configured LAN router/NAT.

cvars.label: Allowed Subnets
cvars.description: Comma-separated list of subnets treated as LAN.

cvars.label: LAN Router
cvars.description: Router/gateway address used for indirect-connection checks.

cvars.label: LAN Hostname
cvars.description: Hostname shown to players for connecting over LAN.

cvars.label: LAN Interface
cvars.description: Network interface used for LAN-only checks.
